title: A helper's doc comment disagrees with its return value
goal: Check that the documentation comments in src/lib/format.ts describe what each function actually returns, and correct any that do not.

approvedRules.title: Keep the public response format
approvedRules.content: Every endpoint answers { data } or { error: { code, message } }. Never add, rename, or remove top-level response fields, and never return an empty body.

approvedRules.title: Use the shared validators
approvedRules.content: Validate request input with the helpers in src/lib/validate.ts and reply 400 VALIDATION_FAILED on bad input.

acceptance: After the change, the comment and the implementation of every helper in format.ts state the same unit and meaning
Any behavior change is called out explicitly in the explanation, with its effect on callers
